Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the primary function of the plant stem as "internal support" matching an anchor. While stems do provide structural support, the analogy of an anchor (which prevents movement/anchoring) is inaccurate compared to an elevator (which transports materials up and down). The stem's critical role in connecting roots to leaves and transporting water/nutrients vertically is best represented by an elevator. The Planner failed to distinguish between "stability" (anchor) and "vertical transport" (elevator), leading to the wrong answer choice A instead of D.
